modern: Neither in writing nor in reading will you be able to lay down rules for others before you have first learned to obey rules yourself. This is much more so in life.
original: Neither in writing nor in reading wilt thou be able to lay down rules for others before thou shalt have first learned to obey rules thyself. Much more is this so in life.
